newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European bunkers dip, buyers await further losses.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers dip, buyers await further losses.

text.p: European bunkers were steady to soft on Tuesday as the entire energy complex weakened, while the expectation of further losses silenced buyers, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST dropped by around $3 to $112 fob. Barges were down $2 and, after reasonable morning trading, calmed down.
Total ARA bunker volumes were low. Suppliers said buyers were waiting for expected price cuts this week.
Amsterdam and Antwerp remained within reach of barge traffic, although still only in convoys behind ice breakers.
Hamburg prices were steady at around $128 fob.
As in ARA, a number of enquiries emerged, but resulted in barely any clinched deals.
Mediterranean prices were steady to weak.
Spanish bunkers weakened by around $2 a tonne.
French prices were steady, propped up slightly by improving demand in the south of the country.
Egyptian fuel oil bunkers dipped by $1 a tonne.
